selected_problem: Fresh main validates status against the published v0.2 enum on durable reads, but RunStore.update guarded status validation with truthiness. Explicit falsy values such as empty string, null, 0 or false bypassed both the terminal transition guard and enum guard, were persisted, and made the next read fail.（最新主分支会在持久化读取时按 v0.2 已公开枚举验证 status，但 RunStore.update 使用真值判断保护状态验证；显式传入空字符串、null、0、false 等假值会同时绕过终态转换门与枚举门，被持久化后导致下一次读取失败。）
